asr.full_text: This is Shah and AVAX is now reacting exactly from the structure we discussed earlier. The market already rejected a major resistance and the current bounce might simply be setting up the next lower high before another drop. Right now AVAX is trading around 9 dollars. In the last update we talked about the rejection from the 9.8 resistance level. That rejection was important because it confirmed that sellers were defending that zone has been making lower lows and lower highs which is the classic sign of a continuing downtrend each bounce has been weaker than the previous one and sellers have been stepping in at resistance levels now after the recent drop the market is attempting a small bounce again but this bounce needs to be understood in the context of the current trend right, the price is most likely moving up to form another lower high inside the bearish structure. As long as AVAX continues to stay below the resistance zones above, the overall direction remains to the downside. The market is still respecting the bearish structure and has not shown any confirmation of reversal yet from the current levels the price could still move slightly higher and re-test the 9.4 area that level is important because it acts as a bearish order block on the chart order blocks often become zones where large sellers previously entered the market so when price revisits those areas rejection can happen again if avax moves up and taps the 9. So when price revisits those areas rejection can happen again. If AVAX moves up and taps the 9.4 bearish order block that could become the next point where sellers step in once again. A rejection from that area would likely push the market back down and continue the move toward the next support around 8.22. The structure right now is clear. Lower highs and lower lows are still forming. Which means the trend has not changed. Until the market starts breaking above resistance levels and invalidating the bearish structure, the downside scenario remains the dominant direction. That why it is important not to fight the trend. Many traders try to catch a reversal too early, but the chart is still showing a clear downward structure. The key levels to watch are very simple. The resistance around 9.4 acting as a bearish order block above, and the support around 8.22 sitting below the current price.
